summary: The aurora shader effect is retired (ADR 0025) and one PARAMETRIC ground written for this library replaces it: fx("gradient"). A keyword token picks the look — --ui-fx-gradient-look: wash (a calm field, the default), sweep (two big forms lit across their bodies), fold (light panes with lit rims), rise (a horizon with a crisp rim) or dawn (a soft horizon: light rising from below the frame) — and shared knobs tune any look: --ui-fx-gradient-angle, -sharpness, -scale, -chroma, -intensity, the quiet zone (-quiet, -quiet-x, -quiet-y) and -dissolve; four knobs follow the look at auto (angle, intensity, the quiet zone's size and height), so look: rise or dawn alone puts the horizon low and the copy in the sky. Knobs inherit (defaults on :root), so a wrapper or brand scope can set them; the colours fall back to the scope's --ui-bg-base and --ui-bg-accent; numbers are read with their CSS unit, an unreadable value warns once and reads as the default, and every knob is clamped. Forced colours draw nothing. Two colour tokens (--ui-fx-gradient-base, default --ui-bg-base; --ui-fx-gradient-light, default --ui-bg-accent) with every other tone derived in OKLab: chroma falls with lightness and darker tones turn away from yellow-green, so a pale-yellow brand's shadows go amber, not olive. Every pixel ends in a static one-step triangular dither, so slow ramps no longer band; copy keeps its contrast in a QUIET ZONE of the exact base instead of aurora's per-pixel guard, which held 4.5:1 by squeezing dark grounds to a few grey levels; the edge fade is separable (no diagonal creases). fx("grain") adds visible grain outside the zone. A ground renders at full resolution and at most 30fps (new ShaderDef options adaptive, fps, resolve; keyword uniforms), and its floor before hydration or without WebGL is a faint CSS gradient of the same light. sampleShader() now also returns the resolved uniform values. Halo dithers its alpha. Removed: fx("aurora"), the --ui-fx-aurora-* tokens, the registered --ui-fx-on and the per-pixel guard (fx_guard) in the prelude.

migration.manual: fx("aurora") no longer type-checks. On a ground (a hero band, an empty state), use fx("gradient") and choose a look with --ui-fx-gradient-look (wash, sweep, fold, rise, dawn); place the copy in the quiet zone (bottom left by default, top left for rise and dawn) or move the zone to the copy with --ui-fx-gradient-quiet-x / -quiet-y, or set --ui-fx-gradient-quiet: 0 and put the copy on glass. On a control (Button, Switch, Checkbox, Slider, Progress), remove it, or use sheen, grain or glow. Delete any --ui-fx-aurora-* overrides; they do nothing. Sync shader.ts, shader-programs.ts and styles/fx/shader.css together.
